subject: Post-call: Embedding model fit & pilot plan — Aletheia Labs
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Emma Chen <emma.chen@alethiabio.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@alethiabio.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2027 16:15:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call: Embedding model fit & pilot plan — Aletheia Labs

Hi Emma / Samir — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick written recap + proposed next steps so we have a shared plan.

Summary of needs we heard:
- You want semantic search over product research docs + clinical notes (initial index ~100k documents, expect to grow).
- Primary success metrics: high recall for top-10 (Recall@10), MRR for FAQ-style queries, and stability over time (drift sensitivity).
- Constraints: PII in clinical notes, on-prem inference possibility later, and budget sensitivity for pilot.

Immediate recommendation (pilot):
1) Run a triage evaluation across three embedding candidates: Redwood-open-embed-large-v1 (dense, 1536d), sbert-mini-384 (compact, 384d), and an int8-quantized variant of open-embed-large (to measure cost-vs-quality).
2) Benchmarks to collect: Recall@1/5/10, MRR, cosine-similarity distribution (to check collapse), nearest-neighbor entropy, and a small drift test (subsetting by month).
3) Prompt/embedding usage: we suggest both raw text embedding and a light pre-processing pass (de-dup, doc chunking 2.5k tokens max). I attached a sample prompt set (alethiabio_promptset_v1.csv) we can use for eval.
4) Acceptance thresholds (draft): Recall@10 >= 0.78 on the seeded QA set; MRR >= 0.55; cosine similarity intra-cluster stdev < 0.12. These are starting points and we should refine after an initial run.

Logistics & ask from you:
- Please confirm a 1) canonical eval set (sample rows or a Google Drive folder) and 2) whether we can temporarily ingest a 1k doc subset for the pilot.
- Any compliance constraints for handling the clinical notes during evaluation (Pseudonymization / secure S3)?

Next steps (our side):
- If you confirm dataset access, we will spin up a pilot job (3 model candidates, index up to 1k docs) and share a short run report in 3 business days with cost/time estimates. Ben will send an estimate for pilot compute.

Attachments: alethiabio_promptset_v1.csv (prompt/test pairs)
Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aLethia-emb-benchmarks, HubSpot: HS-12345678

Thanks — happy to adjust acceptance thresholds if you have historical baselines.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference
From: Emma Chen <emma.chen@alethiabio.com>

Subject: Re: Post-call: Embedding model fit & pilot plan — Aletheia Labs

Karthik — thanks for the thorough recap. That aligns with our thinking. A few quick clarifications: 

1) Dataset: we can share a 1k doc subset (de-identified) today via sample-data@alethiabio.com; full 100k will take a bit longer and involves legal.
2) Baselines: historically our in-house TF-IDF + BM25 setup gets ~0.42 MRR on the seeded QA set — that's the bar we want to beat.
3) Compliance: anything with clinical content must stay on encrypted S3 and we need a written data handling note (we'll need that for the security review).

We are fine with the draft thresholds, but please include an explicit stability check (run the same queries across a time-windowed split and report drift delta for Recall@10).

Can you also give ballpark cost and turnaround for running the 1k-doc triage (3 models) so I can flag procurement? If you can run it this week that would be ideal — our team is accelerated.

Attaching: sample-index-1k.csv (small sample)

Best,
Emma

Subject: Re: Post-call: Embedding model fit & pilot plan — Aletheia Labs

Hi Emma / Samir — looping in a rapid pilot estimate and the evaluation details you asked for.

Short answers first:
- Turnaround: we can run the 1k-doc triage within 48 hours after we get the sample.
- Ballpark cost: for the three-model triage (index + ~3k queries across the prompt set) on Redwood Dedicated instances = ~$650 (on-demand); if you want an on-prem staging run we can provide an estimate but it will add setup time. This includes logging and the drift comparison report.

Evaluation plan (implementation details):
- Models to run: 1) redwood-open-embed-large-v1 (1536 dims), 2) sbert-mini-384 (384 dims), 3) redwood-open-embed-large-v1-int8 (quantized).
- Preprocessing: de-dup + sentence-chunking; chunk length target = 800 tokens with overlap 128.
- Metrics collected: Recall@1/5/10, MRR, Precision@k, cosine distribution histograms, Nearest Neighbor Hamming (for quantized variant), and a drift delta (Recall@10 difference between month-slices).
- Dimensionality checks: we'll compute singular value spread and effective dimensionality (participation ratio) to detect collapse — we often see that quantized reductions change effective dims and can hurt tail recall.

Deliverables:
- Pilot run report (PDF): tables + plots + recommended winner by quality/cost tradeoff.
- Prompt-set stability appendix (we'll run 3 random seeds for candidate prompts to check variance).
- Actionable recommendation: if quality delta between large and quantized <= 3% Recall@10 but cost is 40% lower, recommend quantized for production.

I've attached a short estimate file (pilot-run-estimate.xlsx) and a link to our benchmark folder. If you confirm sample access, I'll kick the job and share the run id and logs.

— Ben
